{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Exclude rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
df_clean = df_dedup[df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 3: Compute the mean baseline biomarker value
mean_baseline = df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print all required numbers:
print(f"Number of patients after deduplication: {len(df_dedup)}")
print(f"Number of patients after removing -999 values: {len(df_clean)}")
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value: {mean_baseline}")

mean_baseline"}
